name: 33161 · North Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33161 (North Miami) has 207 nonprofit organizations. 65 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33161 (North Miami) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
75% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
